ns2:course.label: Introduction to Horticulture
ns2:course.description: Basic principles of plant growth and development as they apply to the production, marketing, and utilization of fruits, vegetables, and ornamental plants. Credit is not given for both HORT 100 and HORT 106.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given for both HORT 100 and HORT 106.
